title: Ledger data migration fails reconciliation
description: 14% of open-item records mismatch between legacy ledger and ERP after the second trial load.
response: Dedicated data-cleansing squad; reconciliation rules agreed with Finance; steering committee decision on a third trial load.

title: Year-end close overlaps with cut-over window
description: Planned cut-over falls in the Finance year-end close; Finance will not release users.
response: Negotiate cut-over after the close or split go-live into two phases.

title: ERP consultant contract ends in December
description: The two senior ERP consultants are contracted only until 31 Dec 2026.
response: Extension quotation requested; knowledge-transfer sessions scheduled.

title: Bank interface certification
description: Payment interface needs certification by the house bank (6-8 weeks lead time).
response: Submit certification request now; track weekly with the bank.

title: Chart of accounts frozen by 31 March
description: Assumed no further changes to the chart of accounts after March. Eleven change requests have since been raised.
response: Assumption no longer holds; add change-control gate for account changes.

title: Peak-season load testing starts late
description: Load tests are scheduled in December, close to the January launch.
response: Bring forward performance test environment booking.

title: SSO provider API stays stable
description: Assumed the identity provider will not change its API before launch.
response: Confirm roadmap with the provider each quarter.

title: Works council approval for time tracking
description: The works council must approve the time-tracking feature before release.
response: Early workshop held; approval meeting set for 18 Nov.

title: App-store review delay
description: iOS review took 9 days instead of the planned 3.
response: Submit earlier in the sprint; buffer added to plan.

title: Scanner firmware incompatible with WMS v9
description: Handheld scanners crash on batch confirmation; vendor patch not yet available.
response: Vendor escalation; interim workaround with older scanner profile.

title: DBA over-allocation delays schema migration
description: The only DBA is allocated at 140% across four projects.
response: Request contractor DBA for 3 months; re-prioritise portfolio DBA time.

title: Cut-over during Q1 stock-take
description: Current plan places go-live in the annual stock-take window.
response: Move go-live to mid-February or run a parallel pilot site first.

title: Hardware delivery from vendor
description: Replacement scanners must arrive by end of November.
response: Weekly delivery check-in; second supplier as fallback.

title: Source-system owners delay data extracts
description: Three departments have not released extract access.
response: Sponsor letter sent; extract workshop booked.

title: Cloud run-cost above forecast
description: Query costs are 18% above the modelled monthly estimate.
response: Introduce cost alerts and partitioning review.

title: Cloud landing zone from P12
description: Data platform needs the landing zone delivered by Cloud Migration Wave 2.
response: Joint milestone plan with P12.

title: Pen-test findings exceed remediation capacity
description: Expected finding volume could exceed available engineering time.
response: Risk-rank findings; agree acceptance criteria for low severity.

title: Security tooling licences approved
description: Assumed licence budget is approved without a new business case.
response: Approval confirmed on 2026-08-22.

title: Low sales-team adoption
description: Only 48% of users attended CRM training; pilot teams still use spreadsheets.
response: Sales directors to mandate attendance; add regional super-users.

title: Q4 quota season limits UAT availability
description: Sales users are not available for acceptance testing in November.
response: Shorten UAT scope to critical flows; evening sessions.

title: ERP integration delayed by P01
description: Customer master data integration depends on the ERP migration.
response: Define interim file-based interface.

title: Customer master data from P01
description: CRM go-live needs the cleansed customer master from the ERP project.
response: Agree delivery date with P01 programme manager.

title: Regulator review date is fixed
description: The data-protection regulator review takes place on 14 Dec 2026 and cannot move.
response: Evidence pack 80% complete; mock review planned for 30 Nov.

title: Missing data-processing agreements
description: Six suppliers have not returned signed data-processing agreements.
response: Procurement to apply payment hold on unsigned suppliers.

title: Audit scope stays unchanged
description: Assumed the regulator will not widen the audit scope.
response: Confirm scope in writing with the regulator.

title: Agency contract renewal
description: The campaign agency contract expires in December.
response: Start renewal discussion in November.

title: Clean contact data from P07
description: Lead scoring needs clean contact data from the new CRM.
response: Interim data-cleansing script as a fallback.

title: Sensor delivery slipped six weeks
description: The vendor delayed the second batch of vibration sensors.
response: Sponsor escalation to the vendor; pilot plant 2 re-sequenced.

title: Pilot data quality too low for modelling
description: Early sensor data has 22% gaps.
response: Add buffering at the edge; synthetic augmentation test.

title: Maintenance team available for pilot
description: Assumed plant teams can support two pilot days per week.
response: Agree roster with plant managers.

title: Search relevance tuning
description: Intranet search returns irrelevant results for HR terms.
response: Synonym list and boosting rules in progress.

title: Low early adoption
description: Staff may keep using old bookmarks after switch-over.
response: Redirect old URLs; communication plan.

title: Network latency above SLA
description: Latency between data centre and cloud is 64 ms vs 40 ms SLA.
response: Dedicated connection upgrade ordered; delivery in 4 weeks.

title: Cut-over collides with month-end
description: Wave 2 cut-over weekend coincides with financial month-end.
response: Move cut-over by one week; confirm with Finance.

title: Cloud architect over-allocated
description: The cloud architect is allocated at 120% across three projects.
response: Backfill with contractor; defer design reviews on P05.

title: Security baseline from P06
description: Application migrations need the approved security baseline.
response: Baseline v1 published; v2 due in November.

title: ERP source data changes after P01 go-live
description: Report logic depends on ledger structures that will change.
response: Isolate source mappings in a configuration layer.

title: Finance users can attend design workshops
description: Assumed two workshops per month with Finance analysts.
response: Review after month-end.

title: Answer accuracy below target
description: Chatbot answers are correct in 61% of test cases; the target is 85%.
response: Improve retrieval and prompt design; limit scope to top-20 intents.

title: LLM usage costs above forecast
description: Usage costs are 2.1 times the forecast during testing.
response: Response caching and model tiering; cost cap per conversation.

title: Scope creep: voice channel
description: Stakeholders asked for a voice channel without change control.
response: Route through change control; defer to phase 2.

title: Training data privacy review
description: Support transcripts used for evaluation need a GDPR review.
response: Anonymise transcripts; legal review scheduled.

title: Supplier onboarding adoption
description: Smaller suppliers may not use the portal.
response: Onboarding webinars; paper fallback for 6 months.

title: Vendor master data from P01
description: The supplier master is migrated by the ERP project.
response: Interim extract from legacy system.

title: Invoice PDF layout bug
description: Some invoice PDFs render incorrectly.
response: Fixed in release 0.9.4.
